description: Call any service operation repeatedly with paging and aggregate the items across pages for bulk exploration.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch, defaults to 5.

page_size.description: Number of items per page, defaults to 100.

params.description: Additional parameters to pass to the operation.

service.description: API service ID, such as public_data_standard, procurement_statistics, product_list, or shopping_mall.

name: call_api_with_pagination_support
